basic_details.job_title: BITS Pilani Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pharmacy at Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani, Hyderabad Campus has called for one project technical support III on a three-year Department of Biotechnology (DBT)-sponsored project under Prof. Ketaki Belsare, with a fellowship of Rs. 37000/month. Applications with a detailed CV must be emailed to [email protected] by 15 November 2026, with the subject line "application for DBT sponsored project".

how_to_apply: Email the application along with the detailed CV to [email protected].
Write the subject line: application for DBT sponsored project.
The notice names only the detailed CV as the document to send. It prints no application form.

rows.details: Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani, Hyderabad Campus
Expanding the Biocatalytic Toolkit: Machine Learning-Guided Engineering of Phenylalanine Ammonia Lyases for Synthesis of Chiral Pharmaceutical Intermediates (grant No. BT/PR65661/BSA/33/1081/2025)
Department of Pharmacy, BITS-Pilani, Hyderabad Campus

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates should hold a first-class M. Pharmacy degree, M.Sc. Biotechnology, or a degree in a related biomedical or life science discipline, with a strong academic background. The maximum age limit is 27 years. Applicants should have a strong interest in enzyme engineering, directed evolution, and protein design. Hands-on experience in molecular biology techniques, enzymatic/biochemical assays, and basic computational techniques including sequence alignment, phylogenetic reconstruction, genome assembly is desirable. Experience in MD simulation, Rosetta, LigandMPNN, ProteinMPNN will be an added advantage. Candidates with a valid GPAT qualification will be preferred

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship for the project technical support III post is Rs. 37000/month. The project runs for 3 years. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BITS Pilani project technical support III
content_sections.text: The notice names only the detailed CV as the document to send. It prints no application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only qualified and suitable candidates will be called for an online interview. Selected candidates may be permitted to register for the Ph.D. program at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad campus, subject to the fulfillment of requirements according to institute norms.
